title: The Rate at Which Interest Is Taken on an Auto Loan Settled in Full
content:
The settlement rate on a loan of the Auto Loans line is read from the borrower's purchases on their Personal Credit Cards account over the last twelve months, together with the scheduled installments credited to the loan over the same twelve months.

| Card purchases over the last twelve months | Scheduled installments credited in the last twelve months | Settlement rate |
|---|---|---|
| At least 12000.00 USD | At least 12 | The floor rate the product publishes |
| At least 3000.00 USD, with either reading short of the row above | At least 8, with either reading short of the row above | The rate recorded on the loan, less the automatic-payment reduction the product publishes |
| Any other reading | Any other reading | The rate recorded on the loan |

The settlement rate is the floor rate the product publishes where the borrower's card purchases over the last twelve months total at least 12000.00 USD and at least 12 scheduled installments have been credited to the loan in the last twelve months.

It is the rate recorded on the loan less the automatic-payment reduction the product publishes where those purchases total at least 3000.00 USD and at least 8 scheduled installments have been credited in that window, while either those purchases fall short of 12000.00 USD or those installments fall short of 12.

It is the rate recorded on the loan for every other borrower.

## Readings that fall to the middle row

A borrower with 12000.00 USD of card purchases and 11 installments credited falls to the middle row, the installments falling short of 12 while both middle-row readings are met.

A borrower with 11999.99 USD of card purchases and 12 installments credited also falls to the middle row, this time on the purchases.

A borrower with 7 installments credited falls to the bottom row whatever their card purchases.
